newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar lower, stays rangebound pre-holiday.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar lower, stays rangebound pre-holiday.

text.p: LIFFE sugar eased in still rangebound pre-holiday trade, With New York providing no strong impetus, traders said.
"New York's exactly the same. Both markets are rangebound," one trader said. There was support at current levels but the market lacked any real fundamental news, he said.
"For the past week we haven't seen it move more than a dollar either way. The dollar is the range," he said.
By 1630 GMT May was 60 cents down at $305.50, having ranged between $305.40 and $306.00. May dominated with 1,209 of a total 1,682 lots traded by then.
"You would have thought that at some stage it would break out, but there's no sign of it," another trader said.

He was expecting the next move to be down. "There's so much sugar floating around," he said "On a fundamental basis you have to say it should come down, but a lot of producers are not shifting sugar," he said.
